themes_detail.label: Dead Animal Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Dead animal complaints spiked to 18 reports this week versus a 3.4-per-week baseline over the prior 8 weeks—a 433% increase (z-score: 4.88)—suggesting a potential public health hazard, disease vector issue, or wildlife management failure across CD 108 this week.
evidence: 18 dead animal complaints filed this week versus 3.4 average weekly complaints over prior 8 weeks
433% spike with z-score of 4.88 indicates statistically severe anomaly
Spike appeared THIS WEEK, not historical pattern
reporting_angles: Interview DSNY about cause: disease outbreak, wildlife influx, seasonal die-off, or inadequate removal response?
Map complaint locations to identify geographic hotspot (parks, streets, residential blocks)
Public health angle: Are residents exposed to disease vectors or contaminated areas?

themes_detail.label: Park Noise Explosion
themes_detail.summary: Park noise complaints jumped to 3 reports last week from a 0.1-per-week baseline—a 2,300% spike (z-score: 8.69)—indicating a sudden and acute noise disturbance event or venue activity emerging in Upper East Side parks this week.
evidence: 3 park noise complaints filed last week versus 0.1 average over prior 8 weeks
2,300% increase with z-score of 8.69 represents the most extreme spike in dataset
Spike is NEW (last week only), not sustained pattern
reporting_angles: Which parks are affected? (Central Park, smaller neighborhood parks?)
What triggered the noise: permitted events, construction, new vendors, or illegal gatherings?
Have Parks Dept received permit applications or noise variance requests for this week?

themes_detail.label: Unleashed Dog Surge
themes_detail.summary: Unleashed dog complaints surged to 4 reports last week from a 0.4-per-week baseline—a 967% increase (z-score: 7.49)—signaling a sudden safety and public health concern in Upper East Side parks and streets this week.
evidence: 4 unleashed dog complaints last week versus 0.4 average weekly baseline
967% spike with z-score of 7.49 indicates severe statistical anomaly
Coincides with dead animal spike (this week), suggesting possible wildlife/pet management crisis
reporting_angles: Are loose dogs connected to dead animal spike? (predation, disease transmission)
Has Parks Dept enforcement presence decreased, or are owners ignoring leash laws?
Safety angle: Have there been incidents (bites, attacks) preceding complaints?

themes_detail.label: Day Care Violations Spike
themes_detail.summary: Day care complaints jumped to 3 reports last week from a 0.6-per-week baseline—a 380% increase (z-score: 4.91)—indicating potential licensing, safety, or sanitation failures in Upper East Side childcare facilities this week.
evidence: 3 day care complaints filed last week versus 0.6 average over prior 8 weeks
380% spike with z-score of 4.91 represents statistically significant anomaly
Spike is NEW (last week only), not historical issue
reporting_angles: What specific violations are being reported? (staffing ratios, sanitation, safety)
Has NYC DOE/ACS expanded inspections or received complaints about a particular facility?
Parent safety angle: Which day cares are involved, and have families been notified?

themes_detail.label: Building/Use Violations Surge
themes_detail.summary: Building/use violation complaints climbed to 9 reports last week from a 2.1-per-week baseline—a 324% increase (z-score: 7.42)—suggesting illegal conversions, occupancy violations, or unpermitted commercial activity in Upper East Side buildings this week.
evidence: 9 building/use complaints last week versus 2.1 average weekly baseline
324% spike with z-score of 7.42 indicates statistically severe deviation
Aligns with 2,003 DOB alteration filings in past 90 days—potential enforcement gap
reporting_angles: Are complaints concentrated in areas with heavy renovation activity (link to DOB permits)?
What types of violations? (illegal conversions to short-term rentals, unpermitted commercial spaces, SRO expansion)
Is DOB keeping pace with enforcement of the 2,003 recent alteration filings?
